facts.text: The fruit depicted in the image is a potato. Although commonly mistaken as a vegetable, potatoes are technically fruits because they are the edible, ripened ovary of a flower, containing seeds. However, in culinary and everyday contexts, potatoes are often referred to as a vegetable due to their savory flavor and uses in dishes. The botanical classification of a potato as a fruit comes from its origin as the tuberous part of the Solanum tuberosum plant, which produces flowers and subsequently the potato as a fruit that grows underground.
